background: Morgan Stanley is the holding company of a leading US investment bank whose earnings have shifted toward wealth and investment management alongside institutional securities, with a deposit franchise built on brokerage sweeps.
synthesis: Fitch rates the group A+, S&P A- and Moody's A1, all stable, with the last move Fitch's upgrade to A+ on 4 Nov 2022. Capital is mixed against US banks, with CET1 of 14.9% in the top quarter but leverage of 4.9% in the bottom quarter, and leverage has fallen 0.6 points since 30 Jun 2025. Liquidity is strong, with LCR of 129% in the top quarter. The one flagged item, on 3 Sep 2026, is a court ruling in a dispute over diversity documents, which does not bear on its credit.
